description: Make compositions from footage or compositions in the Project panel (File > New Comp from Selection): one per item, or one holding them all, sized and timed from an item, optionally with the layers in sequence and added to the Render Queue

addToRenderQueue.description: Add each new composition to the Render Queue

mode.description: each: one composition per item (the default); single: one composition with every item as a layer, the first on top

name.description: single: the composition name; default the first item's name

overlap.description: sequenceLayers: seconds each layer overlaps the one before

sequenceLayers.description: single: place the layers one after another in time

useDimensionsFrom.description: single: the item id whose size and frame rate the composition takes; default the first item

name: create_comp_from_items
title: Create Comp From Items
